items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I went to Jimmy Straits with a fellow named Scotty, a great drummer

ctx.x: Any New Orleans guys in those bands?

No. Then I went with this show called The Royal American, that's the biggest show on the road, I played with them three years. I left them and went to Silas Green and played with him two and a half years, after that, see. When I left Silas Green, well, I went to Jimmy Straits with a fellow named Scotty, a great drummer, that's when I left him and come on to New Orleans in 56. Got Scott taking him, he was getting sick, he wanted me to stay up there, but I stole it off from him. The fellow was leaving, coming to…
When did you get here, what year?
